name: cjk-web-fonts-workspace
description: CJK web fonts, ready to use.

scripts.build: pnpm build:jigmo && pnpm build:hanamin && pnpm build:taipei-sans-tc && pnpm build:fusion-pixel-font && pnpm build:glow-sans-tc-compressed && pnpm build:glow-sans-tc-condensed && pnpm build:glow-sans-tc-normal && pnpm build:glow-sans-tc-extended && pnpm build:glow-sans-tc-wide && pnpm build:iansui && pnpm build:lxgw-wenkai-tc && pnpm build:chiron-sung-hk && pnpm build:chiron-hei-hk && pnpm build:chiron-go-round-tc
scripts.check: pnpm validate:workspace && pnpm site:data:check && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm site:check
scripts.format: oxfmt --check .changeset .github .impeccable/*.json AGENTS.md DESIGN.md PRODUCT.md astro.config.mjs fonts.json package-size-policy.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml site scripts/*.mjs tsconfig.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/README.md README.md
scripts.format:write: oxfmt .changeset .github .impeccable/*.json AGENTS.md DESIGN.md PRODUCT.md astro.config.mjs fonts.json package-size-policy.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml site scripts/*.mjs tsconfig.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/README.md README.md
scripts.site:build: pnpm site:data:check && astro build && node scripts/build_pwa.mjs
